messages:
akshay_csm: Quick heads-up — Nimbuslytics onboarding showing intermittent tail latency on long instruction sequences (~>1.2s P95 on /generate). Renewal flagged 60d out, want to avoid churn.

maria_engineering: Thanks — do we have the recent request distribution? Is it mostly long-context summarization or chat histories?

akshay_csm: Mostly long summarize jobs (user-upload -> summarize with 8k context). Spike correlates with peaks in average seq len. Observed >40% requests >2k tokens during batch windows.

oliver_sre: Can we try a two-pronged hedge: 1) canary swap to compact quantized model for tail-heavy routes, 2) routing policy to divert large-sequence requests to Dedicated pool in eu-west for better cache locality.

june_support: +1. Also customer reported a few 504s yesterday; they posted logs in support ticket #4581. I clipped the stack traces.

akshay_csm: Proposal: perform a staged switch this week. Step 1: create a canary route /generate?profile=compact-q4_0 for 10% traffic (low-risk endpoints only). Step 2: set KV cache ttl=30m for summarization pipelines. Step 3: monitor quality delta with our eval set (baseline vs q4).

maria_engineering: Sounds good. Quick config snippet for canary routing we can push in Console: 

```yaml
routes:
  - name: nimbus-summarize-canary
    match: "/generate"
    conditions:
      - header: X-Workload-Type
        eq: summarization
    model: redwood/compact-v1-q4_0
    split: 0.10
    fallback: redwood/compact-v1-fp16
```

oliver_sre: I'll add autoscale limits + capacity reservation on dedicated eu-west nodes to accept >2k token requests. Also will add a routing rule that redirects requests with header `X-Estimated-Tokens>2000` to that pool.

june_support: For the 504s — correlating those timestamps with the spike windows shows queued requests at the edge. Can we enable early-reject for requests that exceed 12s total processing time? We should notify the customer first.

akshay_csm: Agree. I'll draft the customer note: summarize diffs, explain canary, invite to a shared scoreboard. Will also include rollback plan.

maria_engineering: One more thing — run a small A/B quality check: sample 200 summarize requests, run baseline fp16 vs q4_0 and compute ROUGE/LR score. If degradation >2% we abort. I can run the eval harness tomorrow and drop results in this thread.

oliver_sre: Deploy-bot, please trigger canary to 10% on staging first.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout queued: staging -> 10% -> wait 30m -> promote to prod 10%. See run id: rbw-roll-9123. Logs will be posted in #eng-releases. :gear:
